title: Love of Your Life
plot_overview: A chance encounter sparks a sweeping romance for a young nurse, but a sudden upheaval changes the course of her life. As she travels and faces the weight of loss, she begins an unexpected journey toward finding a way to love and live again.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you want a heartfelt, emotionally heavy story about love, grief, and finding a way forward; Not for you if you’re looking for a light, feel-good romance.
review_summary: Pros: moving lead performance; honest grief themes; pandemic perspective | Cons: uneven later stretch; familiar story shape; slow pacing
